create_LieTensor_from_SE3: create a LieTensor from SE3 group elements using SE3.rand or SE3.identity for random or identity transforms
compose_LieTensor_transforms: compose two LieTensor transforms together using the compose method or multiply operator to chain group operations
transform_points_with_LieTensor: transform 3D points using a LieTensor group element via the transform method or matmul operator
retract_LieTensor_with_delta: retract a LieTensor by a tangent space delta using the retract method to update group elements
compute_jacobian_of_LieTensor_ops: compute Jacobians of LieTensor operations like jcompose, jtransform, or jlog for differentiable geometry
